# Asset credits

Nothing in this project is hotlinked, and no third-party artwork or audio is used.

## Original assets (generated by `scripts/generate_assets.py`)

Creator: generated for this project. Licence: **CC0 1.0** (public domain dedication). No attribution required.

| File | Method | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `public/assets/characters/squelch-idle.svg` | Procedural pixel art (48×48 grid, SVG rects) | Real asset, replaceable |
| `…/squelch-listening.svg`, `-signal.svg`, `-surprised.svg`, `-sleepy.svg`, `-happy.svg` | Same generator, one file per mood | Real asset, replaceable |
| `public/assets/backgrounds/lowtide-hollow.svg` | Procedural pixel-art night scene | Real asset |
| `…/scene-factory.svg`, `scene-empty.svg`, `scene-station.svg`, `scene-lamp.svg` | Procedural pixel-art story scenes | Simple placeholders in spirit: functional, but you may want hand-drawn replacements |
| `public/assets/textures/scanlines.svg`, `noise.svg`, `grille.svg` | Hand-written SVG patterns | Real asset (`grille.svg` is currently unused) |
| `public/assets/audio/static-loop.wav` | Synthesised filtered noise | Placeholder-quality sound, works as-is |
| `public/assets/audio/dial-click.wav` | Synthesised click | Placeholder-quality sound |
| `public/assets/audio/tune-in.wav` | Synthesised sweep + two-note chime | Placeholder-quality sound |
| `public/favicon.svg` | Hand-written pixel SVG | Real asset |

## Fonts (downloaded via npm `@fontsource/*`, stored locally)

All fonts are licensed under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1**. Licence texts are in `public/assets/fonts/LICENSE-*.txt`. Attribution is appreciated but not required.

| Font | Files | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pixelify Sans (Stefie Justprince) | `pixelify-sans-latin-400/700-normal.woff2` | Headings |
| Silkscreen (Jason Kottke) | `silkscreen-latin-400-normal.woff2` | System labels, buttons |
| VT323 (Peter Hull) | `vt323-latin-400-normal.woff2` | Terminal / LED readouts |
| Space Mono (Colophon Foundry) | `space-mono-latin-400/700-normal.woff2` | Body text |

Only the Latin subset of each font is included.

## Still to replace (optional)

- The four story scenes and the three sounds are functional stand-ins. Swap files with the same names to upgrade them.
- Squelch is a consistent pixel design, not final key art. If you commission or generate hand-drawn art, keep the six mood file names.
